title: Plynth generator declaration, version 1
description: The JSON in the module docstring of a generator file, Library/generators/<id>.py. The docstring is the first thing in the file after blank lines and # comment lines, and its first line is plynth-generator. The generator id is the file stem. The file defines generate(gen), which the Blender build calls (docs/GENERATORS.md). Lengths are metres, angles degrees. What a generator makes sits around the origin: its bottom centre at (0, 0, 0), its front toward -Y, width along X, depth along Y.

name.description: Shown in the app, for example Column.

addons.description: Short module names of the Blender add-ons it needs: the last dotted part of the module, lower case, for example archimesh, home_builder_5, bool_tool, bagapie or asset_optimizer. Without one of them enabled the generator is unavailable.

size.description: How the size of what it makes follows from its values: width along its own x, depth along its own y, height up. The plan draws this footprint and the build warns when the result reaches more than 1 cm past it.

length.description: A fixed length above 0, or param * times + plus, where param is a number or integer parameter.

help.description: One plain sentence for the tooltip.

default.description: number: a number, or ceiling_height (unit m only) for the floor's ceiling height at the time it is placed. integer: a whole number. boolean: true or false. choice: one of the choice ids. material: a materials catalog id, or null for the neutral look.

step.description: The step of the app's spin box. Default 0.01 for m, 1 for deg and integers, 0.1 otherwise.
